review.tagline: Agent harness that runs sub-agents, memory and sandboxed skills for long tasks
review.summary: DeerFlow 2.0 is a ByteDance agent harness where a lead agent delegates to sub-agents, backed by long-term memory, a sandboxed file system and extensible skills. It includes a web UI, a Gateway, MCP support, IM channels, scheduled tasks, a terminal UI and an embedded Python client. It is a ground-up rewrite that shares no code with v1.
review.audience: Engineers self-hosting a multi-agent harness for research and long-running tasks
strengths: Interactive `make setup` wizard generates config.yaml and .env in about 2 minutes
Web UI model registration for OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Qwen, Doubao, Kimi, Zhipu, MiniMax
Tracing via LangSmith, Langfuse and Monocle, plus `make doctor` and `make support-bundle`
Many search and fetch backends: Brave, Tavily, Jina, Firecrawl, Crawl4AI, InfoQuest
weaknesses: README warns improper deployment carries security risks; Gateway admin equals code execution
Local development needs Python 3.12+ and Node.js 22+
README is dense with config detail; RAM and hardware needs are not stated
v2 shares no code with v1; v1 users must stay on the 1.x branch
needs: Needs LLM provider API key, Python 3.12+, Node.js 22+
Models: OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Qwen, Doubao
